## Everything you need. Nothing you don't.

Each feature is built to close the gap between where you are and where you want to be. No bloat, no theatrics, AI-powered precision tools that get you hired faster.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know before getting started.

### I'm still a student / recent grad. Will ResAlign work for me?

ResAlign was built for exactly this moment. As a student, you have skills, projects, and potential that ATS systems can't see because your resume doesn't speak their language yet. ResAlign analyzes what you actually bring to a role — not just years of experience — and builds a roadmap to close the gaps that matter. Whether it's your first job search or your twentieth application, you'll know exactly where you stand and what to do next.
